description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This is a pivotal leadership opportunity for a Registered Nurse passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for nursing staff. You will play a critical role in shaping the quality of care and operational excellence within our facility.

As the Director of Nursing, you will oversee all nursing operations, ensuring compliance with state and federal regulations while maintaining high standards of clinical practice. This role offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, reflecting your expertise and leadership contributions. We are looking for a leader who can inspire and guide our nursing team to achieve outstanding outcomes.

This is an urgent opening, and we are actively seeking qualified candidates to join our team. If you are a visionary nursing leader ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply promptly.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing leadership experience, preferably in a skilled nursing facility
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
Demonstrated ability to manage and mentor nursing staff
Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $85,000 to $95,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
